Contacts.metadataDescription: SafetyHub contacts: phone and WhatsApp for questions about online occupational safety and health training, testing and the issuing of electronic certificates with QR verification.
Contacts.title: Contact SafetyHub
Contacts.description: We’ll recommend a programme and answer your training questions.
Contacts.method: A convenient way to get in touch
Contacts.hint: For a faster reply, include the course topic and approximate number of participants.

Faq.metadataDescription: Common questions about SafetyHub courses: how to enrol, how long the test takes, how many correct answers are needed, when the certificate arrives and how to verify it by QR code.
Faq.title: Answers before you start training
Faq.description: A quick guide to courses, tests and your account. If your question is not covered, contact us and we’ll help.
Faq.phoneQuestion: Can I complete training on my phone?
Faq.phoneAnswer: Yes. Materials, tests and your account work on phones, tablets and computers. You do not need to install a separate app.
Faq.countQuestion: How many questions are in a test?
Faq.countAnswer: Every test contains exactly {questionCount} questions. You need at least {passScore} correct answers, or {passPercent}%, to pass.
Faq.resultQuestion: Where can I see my best result?
Faq.resultAnswer: After signing in, open your profile. It shows your best score, attestation status and available certificates for each course without listing individual attempts.

AuthZh.title: Account access
AuthZh.description: Chinese users sign in with a Latin username and a password.
AuthZh.usernameHint: 3–32 characters; starts with a lowercase Latin letter and may use digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

AuthZh.passwordHint: At least 12 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes, with upper and lower case letters and digits.
AuthZh.passwordInvalid: At least 12 characters, with upper and lower case letters and digits.
AuthZh.legalRequired: Accept the terms of use and the privacy policy first.

AuthZh.autoLoginPending: The account was created; signing you in securely…

AuthZh.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
AuthZh.registerHint: An administrator reviews the account after it is created. Neither sign-in nor review needs an email or a phone number.
AuthZh.loginHint: If you cannot sign in or you forgot the password, contact an administrator: after verifying you, they can reset it. There is no self-service recovery.

AccountDeletion.title: Permanent deletion
AccountDeletion.description: This request immediately closes access and starts background cleanup of your profile, photo, attempts, results, certificates and related data. QR certificate verification will stop working. PDFs already saved to other devices cannot be removed.
AccountDeletion.failed: Could not send the deletion request.
AccountDeletion.requested: Your deletion request was accepted. Access is closed while server cleanup continues in the background.
